review_evidence: CRT_Product_Tree.thy: Contains datatype definitions (prodtree), well-formedness predicates (wf_prodtree), mapping functions (map_prodtree'), remainder tree computation (mod_prodtree), linear combination (comb_prodtree), and Chinese remaindering algorithm (crt_prodtree) with theorems snd_crt_prodtree and cong_fst_crt_prodtree proving correctness
